==Proto-Semitic==

===Etymology===
Reconstructed in Militarev & Kogan's ''Semitic Etymological Dictionary'' as {{m|sem-pro|*šVt-}}, with a variant with prothetic {{m|sem-pro|*ʔi-}}: {{m|sem-pro|*ʔi-šVt-}}. The vowel of the base is given as {{m|sem-pro|*i}} on SEDonline.

===Noun===
{{sem-noun|?}}

# [[buttocks]], [[posterior]]
